What should be done at a temperature below 35.5 degrees?

segments.text: (Refer to STW on thermal care of newborn)
Temperature <35.5°C: nurse under a radiant warmer in servo mode.

If unwell or temperature fails to improve, nurse under a warmer.

title: Triage DOs
example_questions: What are the DOs in the neonatal triage STW?
What should be done for every neonate on arrival?

segments.text: Screen every neonate immediately on arrival for emergency and priority signs.
Maintain TABC, assess SpO₂ and blood glucose, and start indicated treatment promptly. Reassess after each intervention.
Administer the first dose of antibiotic within 1 hour if there is a high likelihood of sepsis.

title: Kangaroo Mother Care: Definition
example_questions: What is Kangaroo Mother Care?
How does the KMC STW define kangaroo mother care?

segments.text: Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) is early, continuous and prolonged skin-to-skin contact between a preterm or low birth weight newborn and the mother (or an alternate caregiver), combined with exclusive breastmilk feeding, early discharge when appropriate, and structured follow-up.
